en: $s20After the runaway accident,$s80$s13$s20the Institute was flooded with dense Getter Rays and too dangerous to enter, so it was temporarily shut down.
$s20Until now, the fluctuations$s80$s13$s20inside the cocoon had been unstable, but$s80$s13$s20after that incident just now,$s80$s13$s20they suddenly stabilized.

Y-$s80$s13$s05you can't mean...

en: $s20...evolving?!
Shin Getter Dragon is an unknown machine!$s80$s13$s80$s13If things look dangerous,$s80$s13come back at once!
